Recently confirmed to star in the third season of "Your Friends & Neighbors," actor James Marsden, who plays billionaire Owen Ashe, has this week been confirmed to appear in his third Apple TV production. Details below.

Apple TV has a new mystery comedy in the works

A few months ago, Apple Studios confirmed that James Marsden ("Paradise," "X-Men: Days of Future Past") will star as CIA case officer Brad Griffin in an upcoming thriller series titled "Disavowed."

The announcement came just weeks after the premiere of the second season of "Your Friends & Neighbors," in which he plays billionaire Owen Ashe.

According to Deadline (via MacMagazine), Marsden has now signed on for his third Apple TV project, this time a mystery comedy titled "Bad News Dads."

As with "Disavowed," Marsden will also serve as executive producer. Deadline adds that the series "is created by Stephen Falk, the creator of 'You're the Worst.'"

The report notes that Frost's book "Bad News Dads" is scheduled for publication on April 6, 2027, while the half-hour mystery comedy adaptation for Apple TV is still in development, with no premiere date yet announced.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or it can be subscribed to via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a number of popular series and films, including "Severance," "The Studio," "The Morning Show," "Shrinking" and "Silo."
